Name: Fleeting Emberblade
Components: S, M, V (a finger coated in candle wax)
Description: You create a bright flaming blade that extends from your stretched fingers, quickly swinging it at a creature nearby. You perform a melee spell attack against a creature within reach, dealing 1d8 fire damage on a hit and inflicting 1 Burn.
At Higher Levels: This spell’s damage increases by 1d8 and deals an additional point of Burn when you reach 5th level (2d8, 3), 11th level (2d8, 4), and 17th level (4d8, 5).
